hebrewText: וּ/בְ/הִכָּ֣שְׁלָ֔/ם יֵעָזְר֖וּ עֵ֣זֶר מְעָ֑ט וְ/נִלְו֧וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּ/חֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת

tokens.bdb: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall
tokens.kjv: bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
tokens.enLiteralWord: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
tokens.explanation: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
tokens.explanationEn: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs

tokens.bdb: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
a little or few (often adverbial or compar.)
tokens.kjv: almost (some, very) few(-er, -est), lightly, little (while), (very) small (matter, thing), some, soon, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: properly, to twine, i.e. (by implication) to unite, to remain; also to borrow (as a form of obligation) or (caus.) to lend
tokens.kjv: abide with, borrow(-er), cleave, join (self), lend(-er).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).
tokens.explanation: rav — grande, muito, numeroso, abundante, ancião

tokens.bdb: properly, something very smooth; i.e. a treacherous spot; figuratively, blandishment
